meta.name: Vector layers (demo)
meta.description: Opens Mapbox Vector Tiles as a slide layer aligned to the slide's own pixel grid, for the visualization-flexibility showcase.
meta.longDescription: Registers the `demo-mvt` slide protocol. flex-renderer's MVT tile source derives a square world from the zoom range, which cannot describe a non-square slide; this module constructs the source directly from a descriptor that states the real width and height, so the vector layer aligns with the slide one-to-one. GeoJSON needs no such help and is opened by OpenSeadragon's ordinary autodetection.
